newsitem.title: USA: Revlon names George Fellows CEO.
newsitem.headline: Revlon names George Fellows CEO.

text.p: Cosmetics giant Revlon Inc. said Thursday that President George Fellows would succeed Jerry Levin as chief executive, effective immediately.

The cosmetics and beauty products company said in a statement that Levin would remain chairman of the board. He also will continue as an executive vice president of MacAndrews & Forbes Holdings Inc., which owns 83 percent of Revlon's outstanding common stock.
Fellows will retain the title of president.
"This appointment is a transition that we have long been planning, and now is the ideal time to make this change," Levin said in the statement.
